title: Water Extractable Organic Matter (WEOM)
author: maggie.bowman
materials: Thaw ~ 20 mL sample prior to filtering
SPE Protocol: Gilson Automated SPE Protocol

steps.title: Prepare Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh out 6 g of air-dried soil in triplicate into labeled 50 mL falcon tubes.

steps.title: Extract Organic Matter
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL of Ultrapure DI water to each tube (maintaining a 2 g to 10 mL ratio) using a large pipette.

steps.title: Agitate Samples
steps.instruction: Place samples onto an orbital shaker for 2 hours at 2 rpm.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 6000 rpm for 8 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge a second time if samples remain cloudy.

steps.title: Separate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into two centrifuge tubes, keeping the soil pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 mL into a 15 mL centrifuge tube for FT-ICR-MS.
Transfer ~20 mL into a 50 mL centrifuge tube for TOC/TN and LC-MS.

steps.title: Process FT-ICR-MS Subsample
steps.instruction: Acidify the FT-ICR-MS subsample and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of concentrated phosphoric acid (37%).
Freeze the sample on its side at -80 °C until SPE.

steps.title: Store TOC/TN and LC-MS Samples
steps.instruction: Freeze the TOC/TN and LC-MS sample on its side at -20 °C until filtration.

steps.title: Prepare Filter and Syringe
steps.instruction: Rinse a new 0.45 µm filter using a clean syringe.

substeps.instruction: Pull up 50 mL of Ultrapure DI water using a new clean syringe.
Attach a new 0.45 µm filter to the syringe and press the water through to rinse.
Remove the filter without touching the tip.

steps.title: Filter Thawed Samples
steps.instruction: Filter the thawed TOC/TN and LC-MS sample using the rinsed filter.

substeps.instruction: Pull up ~20 mL of thawed sample into the syringe.
Discard the first 1-2 mL of filtered sample.
Filter 10 mL of solution into a 15 mL tube labeled for LC-MS.
Filter all remaining sample into a 15 mL tube labeled for TOC/TN.

steps.title: Handle Clogged Filters
steps.instruction: Replace the filter if it becomes difficult to press the sample through.

substeps.instruction: Rinse a new filter using a clean DI-only syringe (following the rinse steps).
Attach the rinsed filter to the syringe containing the sample.
Discard the first 1-2 mL and continue filtering into the respective tubes.

steps.title: Store Filtered Samples
steps.instruction: Store filtered samples in the freezer prior to analyses.
